Changing the automatic transmission fluid is not a planned maintenance operation and is only carried out during removing-refitting operations that involve draining the automatic transmission fluid.

- Position the vehicle on a lift.

Op. 7055B54 UNDER ENGINE PROTECTION/GUARD - R.R.

1. Unscrew the automatic transmission fluid drain plug and allow the oil to drain completely into a suitable container.

Do not let the oil disperse into the environment as indiscriminate dispersion of this product causes pollution.

- Fit the engine oil drain plug in its housing complete with new O-ring and tighten it to the recommended torque.
